passed_checks.check_name: Ensure AWS IAM policy does not allow assume role permission across all services
code_block:
Ec2AppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ec2-cloudwatch-logs-and-ssm-parameter-read
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SSMParameterReadByPath
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${SSMParameterPathPrefix}*
              - Sid: KMSDecryptForSecureParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "kms:ViaService": !Sub ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                  StringLike:
                    "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:ssm:parameter-name": !Sub ${SSMParameterPathPrefix}*
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ec2-logs-and-ssm-parameter-access
